name: MiraSession
title: Mira Session
description: One persistent Mira conversation per person per surface. The session_key is the durable handle (an httpOnly cookie value on famile.xyz); it scopes MiraTurn reads and writes without requiring a login. When a real auth layer lands, the session_key becomes the bridge to an authenticated identity.

session_key.description: Opaque random identifier minted by the client surface. Treated as a capability: whoever holds it can read and append to this session.

surface.description: Which Famile surface originated this session. Mira may acknowledge the surface in voice; she never claims memory across surfaces until a shared identity exists.

last_posture.description: Operational posture projected from product state, per docs/MIRA.md. Never inferred from chat sentiment.

valence.description: Scalar -1 (settled) to 1 (disrupted). Modulates the same posture; never invents a new shape name.

turn_count.description: Denormalized count of MiraTurn rows for this session, for cheap hydration.

last_turn_at.description: When the most recent MiraTurn was written. Drives session expiry and LRU pruning.
